pois.label: 电池柜阵 2×4
pois.detail: 8 台 Megapack 级 LFP 集装箱电池柜，2 排 × 4 台立在烧结硬化条形基座上，管昼夜循环。前排 4 台掀盖挖开：顶盖沿背侧铰链后仰 35°，露出 3 层 × 8 只电芯模组，一只抽屉抽出半格；柜间设防爆隔堤。选 LFP 而非 NMC 是为火面安全裕度（热失控温度更高、无氧释放）。
pois.detail_en: Eight Megapack-class LFP containerized cabinets, two rows of four on a sintered-regolith strip foundation, carrying the day-night cycle. The front four are cut open: the lid tilts back 35 degrees on a rear hinge to expose three tiers of eight cell modules, one drawer pulled half out, with blast berms between cabinets. LFP over NMC buys Martian safety margin - a higher thermal-runaway onset and no oxygen release.
sim: L1 PyBaMM（SPMe+集总热, Prada2013）：sol 工况电芯往返效率 99.45%，自热温升 0.04 K
柜级电化学产热仅 0.8 kW，占早期 η=92% 假设的 10% —— 热的主角是 PCS 与辅助系统，不是电池
SOC 日摆动 42%~100%（浅循环，日历老化主导），灯柱按 L0v2 校准调度曲线数据驱动
身份更新（pwr-grid-01 台账，总控裁定）：本场不是「另一张城市电网」——反应堆够得着一切。它的真实身份是**生存电网**：全城 T1 生存层负荷 78 kW（电网册独立算出），本场实证的 145 kW @15% 残余光伏 ×30 sol 覆盖 1.85 倍。两个 session 互不知情而闭合。
sim_en: L1 PyBaMM (SPMe + lumped thermal, Prada2013): 99.45% cell round-trip over the sol cycle, 0.04 K self-heating rise
Cabinet electrochemical heat is only 0.8 kW - 10% of the early eta=92% assumption; the thermal load is really the PCS and auxiliaries, not the cells
SOC swings 42%-100% daily (shallow cycling, calendar-aging dominated); the light-stacks are data-driven from the L0v2-calibrated dispatch curve

Identity update (pwr-grid-01 ledger, integrator ruling): this farm is not a second city grid - the reactor reaches everything. Its real identity is the SURVIVAL GRID: the city T1 survival tier is 78 kW (computed independently by the grid ledger), and this farm verified 145 kW at 15% residual PV for 30 sols - 1.85x coverage. Two sessions closed the loop without knowing of each other.

pois.label: 功率变换站 PCS 2 MW
pois.detail: 两台逆变器橇 + 带四面散热鳍的变压器箱，把电池 DC 与基地 AC 高压母线双向耦合，充放方向与功率全由此决定。裸三相铜母线桥从电池阵上空爬来，充/放端子蓝进橙出。变流器厅设发光窗。
pois.detail_en: Two inverter skids plus a transformer box finned on all four faces couple the battery DC to the base AC high-voltage bus, setting charge/discharge direction and power. A bare three-phase copper busbar bridge climbs in over the battery array; charge and discharge terminals are color-coded blue-in, orange-out. The converter hall carries a lit window.
sim: L3 调度暴露：晴 sol 充电段电池顶着 1 MW 限幅运行 —— PCS 才是真瓶颈，非散热
L0v2 闭环校准：PCS 从 1 MW 扩至 2 MW 后，标称设计点 419 → 833 kW（1.9×），卡口移交辐射板
sim_en: L3 dispatch exposed it: on a clear sol the battery charges pinned against a 1 MW clamp - the PCS, not heat rejection, is the true bottleneck
L0v2 closed-loop calibration: raising the PCS from 1 to 2 MW lifts the nominal design point 419 -> 833 kW (1.9x) and hands the binding limit to the radiators

pois.label: 热管理排热系统
pois.detail: 热/冷双色流体主回路从 PCS 橇南缘引出，经泵组橇（两台泵，前端飞轮 spinner 可视化）送至场区北缘 6 块黑色平板辐射散热器。火星 600 Pa 大气对流近乎无效，排热几乎全靠辐射，故用大面积辐射翼 + 泵驱液冷回路取代地球式空调外机——这是行星工程的招牌特征。
pois.detail_en: A hot/cold two-color fluid main loop leaves the south edge of the PCS skid, passes the pump skid (two pumps with front flywheels shown as spinners) and runs to six black flat-panel radiators along the north edge of the yard. In Mars's 600 Pa atmosphere convection is nearly useless, so heat rejection is almost entirely radiative - large radiating wings plus a pump-driven liquid loop replace the Earth-style AC condenser, a signature of planetary engineering.
sim: L2 COMSOL 稳态传热（单模组均质化, k=2 W/mK）：0.1C 日常工况三种冷却均 ≈27 °C —— 火星被动辐射即够日常散热
1C 应急三案齐超温（被动 188 °C / 冷板 152 °C），瓶颈在模组内部导热，持续调度热上限约 0.3~0.4C
L0v2：效率校准后平均废热 31.4 kW < 37 kW 持续能力，散热瓶颈解除，6 块辐射板不扩容
sim_en: L2 COMSOL steady heat transfer (single homogenized module, k=2 W/mK): all three cooling cases sit near 27 degC at the 0.1C daily duty - passive Martian radiation alone covers daily heat rejection
At 1C emergency duty all three cases overheat (passive 188 degC / cold-plate 152 degC); the bottleneck is conduction inside the module, capping sustained dispatch near 0.3-0.4C
L0v2: after the efficiency recalibration average waste heat is 31.4 kW < 37 kW continuous capacity - the heat-rejection bottleneck clears and the six radiators need no expansion

pois.label: 电解槽
pois.detail: 再生燃料电池链（RFC）的白天段：昼间余电电解水，产 H₂/O₂ 分别压入球罐。RFC 是跨尘暴季长储手段，与管昼夜的电池两级互补——NASA Glenn 月火面电力研究的标准方案。
pois.detail_en: The daytime leg of the regenerative fuel-cell chain (RFC): surplus daytime power splits water and pumps the H2 and O2 into separate spheres. The RFC is the cross-dust-storm long-duration store, complementary to the battery's day-night tier - the standard scheme from NASA Glenn's lunar/Martian surface-power studies.
sim: L0 定盘：单罐 H₂ 存 6.17 MWh 电，30-sol 尘暴仅够 8.3 kW —— 生命维持级备份
L3：15% 残余光伏工况下电池独力扛过 30 sol，燃料电池零启用；RFC 真实定位是 5% 级『黑尘暴』尾部保险
sim_en: L0 sizing: one H2 tank stores 6.17 MWh of electricity, enough for only 8.3 kW across a 30-sol storm - a life-support-level backup
L3: at 15% residual solar the battery alone rides out 30 sols with the fuel cell never starting; the RFC's real role is tail insurance for the 5%-class 'black storms'

pois.label: H₂ / O₂ 立式球罐
pois.detail: 两只支腿架高的立式球罐：H₂ 罐 d3.0 m（绿白环带）、O₂ 罐 d2.2 m（橙环带），罐身液位标尺显示储量。O₂ 罐按化学计量配平后缩小——这是 L0 算出的直接资产修改。
pois.detail_en: Two leg-raised vertical spheres: the H2 tank at d3.0 m (green-and-white band) and the O2 tank at d2.2 m (orange band), with level gauges on the shells. The O2 tank was shrunk after stoichiometric balancing - a direct asset change that fell out of the L0 sizing.
sim: L0 化学计量校核：336 kg H₂ 燃料电池反应只需约 2,668 kg O₂（≈5.5 m³ @350 bar），原 d3.0 O₂ 球体积过剩 2.6×，据此缩至 d2.2 m
sim_en: L0 stoichiometry check: reacting 336 kg H2 in the fuel cell needs only ~2,668 kg O2 (~5.5 m3 @350 bar), so the original d3.0 O2 sphere was oversized 2.6x - shrunk to d2.2 m

pois.label: 燃料电池
pois.detail: RFC 链的尘暴段：全球尘暴遮光数周、光伏残余极低时，燃料电池消耗罐存 H₂/O₂ 发电，生成的水回流电解槽闭环。方舱泄压口朝 +X 无人侧。
pois.detail_en: The storm leg of the RFC chain: when a global dust storm blots the sun for weeks and residual solar is minimal, the fuel cell draws stored H2/O2 to generate power, and the product water returns to the electrolyser to close the loop. The module's pressure-relief vent faces the unmanned +X side.
sim: L3 尘暴生存包线（30-sol，零失负荷）：光伏残余 5%→56 kW，15%→145 kW，25%→234 kW；每变黑 5 个百分点，基地约需多砍 24 kW 负荷
sim_en: L3 dust-storm survival envelope (30-sol, zero load-shed): residual solar 5% -> 56 kW, 15% -> 145 kW, 25% -> 234 kW; each 5-point drop in residual costs the base about 24 kW of load

pois.label: 飞轮储能桶 ×2
pois.detail: 两只真空桶体飞轮储能单元，顶部转子高速旋转（spinner 可视化），负责秒级至分钟级的短时调频，补电化学电池响应速度的不足。
pois.detail_en: Two vacuum-drum flywheel storage units with fast-spinning top rotors (shown as spinners), handling second-to-minute frequency regulation to cover the slower response of the electrochemical battery.

specs.职能: 短时调频 / 功率平滑
